provenance.description: Historical SCImago Journal Rank data mirrored for reproducible literature and journal analysis.

journal_value.description: SCImago Journal Value and estimated APC snapshot.

ranking_policy.publication_year_metric: Use SJR and quartile from the SCImago snapshot matching the publication year.
ranking_policy.latest_metric: Use the latest SCImago snapshot only as current/latest source metadata.
ranking_policy.future_years: Do not label the latest available quartile as the publication-year quartile for a future publication year.

source_status.ACTIVE_LATEST: Source is present in the latest SCImago snapshot.
source_status.HISTORICAL_ONLY: Source appears in an earlier SCImago snapshot but not in the latest snapshot.
source_status.UNMATCHED: Source could not be matched to SCImago.
source_status.AMBIGUOUS: More than one plausible SCImago source match exists.

data_notes.scimago_and_scopus: SCImago uses Scopus data, but presence in a SCImago snapshot must not be treated as proof of current Scopus indexing status.
data_notes.conference_note: Annual SCImago conference/proceedings coverage varies substantially. Absence from a yearly export must not be interpreted as discontinuation from Scopus.
data_notes.quartile_note: Best Quartile and category-specific quartiles are distinct and should both be retained.
data_notes.apc_note: Estimated APC values are snapshot estimates and must not be interpreted as historical APC values.
data_notes.predatory_note: SCImago inclusion or exclusion alone must not be used to classify a venue as predatory.
